user.title: Connect to MeshCentral
user.description: If your account has 2FA enabled, create a Login Token in MeshCentral → My Account → Login Tokens and use those credentials here.

data.login_key: LoginKey (3FA) — leave empty if not used
data.use_ssl: Use SSL (disable if behind reverse proxy with tlsOffload)

data_description.login_key: Server-level LoginKey for 3FA. If your MeshCentral config.json has LoginKey enabled, all requests must include this key. Find it by running the server with --logintokenkey. This is NOT the same as a per-user Login Token (~t:... username).

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed — check username, password and LoginKey

abort.already_configured: This MeshCentral server is already configured
